purpose: Teach: 創り/分別/持ち込ま/金庫/定量/届け出/書式/配管

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 新ブランド、独自で創り上げよう。
lines.en: Let's build this new brand on our own terms.
lines.style: Clear, measured authority. Forward-leaning posture. Each clause lands with quiet conviction. No hesitation—she's thought this through. Steady eye contact.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。リサイクル、分別ルール、社員に共有します。
lines.en: Got it. I'll share the recycling and sorting guidelines with everyone.
lines.style: Immediate, attentive. Slight forward nod. Warm but professional. A beat of confirmation—he's already mentally organizing the task.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 資料、家に持ち込ませない方針、徹底。
lines.en: And no taking materials home—that's non-negotiable.
lines.style: Firm but not harsh. The word 'non-negotiable' lands with quiet steel. Slight pause before it, setting the boundary. Still warm underneath.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。金庫、暗証番号、月一で更新。
lines.en: Understood. The safe code gets updated every month.
lines.style: Quick, efficient confirmation. Slight chin dip—acknowledging the weight of the task. Professional tone, no wasted words. Already making mental notes.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 発注、定量で予測しよう。
lines.en: Let's start predicting our orders at fixed quantities.
lines.style: Thoughtful, collaborative 'let's.' Not a demand. Calm delivery, like she's inviting him into the solution. Slight exhale before the proposal.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。各種届け出、期限内に。
lines.en: I'll handle it. All filings in on time.
lines.style: Short, assured. No rising inflection. The efficiency of someone who knows exactly what's coming. Professional confidence without arrogance.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 契約書式、来週、改訂版に。
lines.en: The contract template goes into the revised version next week.
lines.style: Declarative, no softening. Professional distance—this is information, not negotiation. Steady pace. A hint of 'this is already decided.'

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。建物の配管、点検、明日実施します。
lines.en: All set. I'll have the building's piping inspected tomorrow.
lines.style: Definitive close. Slight lean back—task accepted and filed away. Warm professional tone. The punctuation of someone wrapping up a meeting with care.
